title: Terra Type A2 — Main Unit
description: Virtual tour of the main unit of a Terra Residences Type A2 dual-key apartment. Entrance and foyer, living and dining areas, kitchen, balcony and yard, master bedroom with en-suite, a second bedroom and family bathroom.

scenes.title: Main Entrance
scenes.description: Main entrance to the unit — built-in display shelving and a decorative vase beside the door.

scenes.title: Foyer
scenes.description: Foyer just inside the main entrance, with recessed lighting and a wall-mounted light fitting.

scenes.title: Main Hall
scenes.description: Hallway serving the main unit, looking through to the living, dining and kitchen areas.

scenes.title: Living Room
scenes.description: Living area with a sofa on a patterned rug, opening through to the kitchen counter and dining zone.

scenes.title: Dining
scenes.description: Dining area with table and chairs under pendant lights, adjoining the living room and kitchen.

scenes.title: Kitchen
scenes.description: Kitchen with counter and hob, oven, overhead cabinetry and under-cabinet lighting.

scenes.title: Balcony
scenes.description: Balcony off the living area with railing, sheer curtains and an open outlook.

scenes.title: Yard
scenes.description: Outdoor yard space with a slatted partition screen and plenty of natural daylight.

scenes.title: Master Bedroom — View 1
scenes.description: Master bedroom looking towards the walk-in wardrobe and the door through to the en-suite.

scenes.title: Master Bedroom — View 2
scenes.description: Master bedroom with wall-mounted TV, shelving, curtains and flowers.

scenes.title: Master Bathroom
scenes.description: En-suite master bathroom with glass shower enclosure and tiled walls.

scenes.title: Bathroom 1
scenes.description: Family bathroom with glass shower enclosure and tiled wall.

scenes.title: Bedroom 2
scenes.description: Second bedroom of the main unit.
